show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/2bRF7p
show.description: After ten years behind bars for a murder he didn't commit, rising star Sameer emerged to find his world shattered. His childhood love, Sonia, had climbed the ranks to superstardom, leaving him in the shadows of his past. To reclaim his life, Sameer struck a deal with the powerful CEO Asmita. Amidst dangerous conspiracies and industry sabotage, he fought to expose the truth. In a world of fake glamour, his journey became a brutal quest for justice.
